role: frequency-ordered word list (seed-only language: the app bundles the whole list, nothing to download)
generationVersion: gen-tatoeba-words.py v1 (HKeyboard scripts/; Batch 8 added the kannada script filter, whose vowel signs / virama / anusvara are letters of the word)
generationCommand: python gen-tatoeba-words.py --lang kn --script kannada --min-count 2 --stop "ಟಾಮ್,ಮೇರಿ" --out kn_words.txt kan_text.txt
